Our Story

Move. Explore. Grow.

Childhood is full of firsts. The first push. The first turn. The first time they go a little farther on their own. Talio exists to make those moments more exciting — and give parents a little more confidence along the way.

We believe products for children should be more than something to ride. They should encourage movement, curiosity and independence, while being thoughtfully designed for the families who choose them. That's why we focus on the things that matter: quality, safety, thoughtful design and honest value.

ThoughtfulDesigned with purpose, down to the details.
DependableQuality you can feel confident choosing.
PlayfulMade to encourage movement, curiosity and fun.
